idea-plugin.name: Linux Do (API Docs)
idea-plugin.description:
Linux Do — Unofficial Community Client

An independent, personal project by lgguan, licensed under MIT. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Linux Do or JetBrains. Only https://linux.do is supported.

Supports Windows, macOS and Linux. Requires JetBrains IDE 2026.2 (build 262.*) with its bundled JBR and JCEF plugin.

A native JetBrains IDE plugin for browsing Linux Do (Discourse) community forum, featuring:

  • Developer Documentation / Code Camouflage Mode: Integrates seamlessly into the IDE editor with Monospace/JetBrains Mono typography, Git-Log/Issue-tracker style list, and RFC/Javadoc formatted post reader.
  • DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH): Defaults to LinuxDo DoH (https://ldh.ddd.oaifree.com/query-dns). Custom HTTPS resolvers and system DNS are also available.
  • Cloudflare Verification & Auth: Integrated JCEF authentication to solve Cloudflare Turnstile challenges and persist session credentials securely via PasswordSafe.
  • Browsing & Navigation: Compact topic lists with categories, tags, unread status and relative activity times. Paginated search includes matching excerpts and opens the matching floor. Refresh preserves your selection and position. Return to the floor before a jump.
  • Rich Reading & Composing: Quotes, code blocks with copy actions, tables, link cards, details and spoilers. Shared icon toolbars for topics and replies, formatting menus, image uploads and on-demand preview.
  • Forum Drafts: Resume native topic and reply drafts across the IDE and website. Autosave after two seconds, preserve reply targets, and choose between versions on conflicts. No additional local draft-body files.
  • Topic Categories & Tags: Search category names, parent paths and descriptions; the menu closes after selection. A web-style tag picker shows usage counts, removable selected chips, a search field and category restrictions.
  • Notifications & Read Progress: Notifications and optional reading progress synchronization. Ordinary HTTP 429 prompts a cooldown; Cloudflare verification responses prompt manual verification.
  • Boss Key (Emergency Mode): Hide all topic tabs and the API Docs panel; press again to restore.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.3

  • Personal bookmarks now support server search, name and reminder editing, and confirmed deletion. Reminder policies are preserved; updates synchronize across project windows and readers.
  • The reader bookmark entry opens the personal center. Successful refresh replaces bookmark results, and outdated requests cannot restore deleted entries.
  • Forum and personal modules use accessible icons with active highlighting. Embedded login pages retain Tab and Shift+Tab navigation.
  • Hot topics now use the forum Hot endpoint instead of the daily Top list. Includes the pending personal-content, notification and Markdown-editor improvements.

1.0.2

  • Boost now uses an inline floor popover and avatar bubbles. Server permissions control sending and withdrawing your own Boost. Grapheme-aware limits, IME composition guards and shared submission locks prevent invalid or duplicate sends.
  • Foreground reading measures visible post bodies and independent topic time. A persistent, account-scoped queue retries failed timing batches after login, with bounded batches, request spacing and server cooldowns. Pending synchronization is visible in reading tools.
  • Boost updates preserve body nodes and reading position; live IDE color changes preserve popover input.
  • 楼层号和未读小蓝点移到楼层信息行的最右侧，左侧头像紧邻用户名；已读后楼层信息和正文不再发生位移。
  • 修复首次打开帖子的可见楼层未自动标记已读：计时依据选中文档、正文可见和 IDE 前台状态，允许输入焦点留在话题列表或工具窗口，后台和隐藏文档仍暂停。
  • Expanded advanced search, combined category/tag filtering, consistent tag pickers and live composer theme updates.

1.0.1

  • Fixed stale rendering during window resizing, browser startup hangs after disconnection, and blocked Windows IPC cleanup. Failed readers offer retry and restore the cached topic and floor.
  • Compact, consistent icon actions show only currently available capabilities. Reading tools align with the document header; Share is inside More. Removed redundant floor labels and duplicate bookmark symbols.
  • Post pages follow IDE themes and reading settings immediately. Login and verification trigger one topic-list refresh; foreground reading updates unread markers and synchronizes progress.
  • Added bundled syntax highlighting, MathJax and Mermaid, enhanced image viewing, and controlled click-to-load video embeds.
  • Added paginated topic search, author and popular-reply filters, quote context, a contents menu, bookmarks and notification levels. Long topics use bounded rendering and body caches.
  • Server permissions govern reactions, editing, history, soft deletion, restoration, custom flags, polls and supported topic votes and accepted answers. Updates preserve reading position; failed likes do not reload the page.
